values.note: Water at every site; many sites also have electric and sewer (amperage not stated).

hookups.source: https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Our-Parks/Smith-Point-County-Park ('All sites have water, and many have electric hookups and sewers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations are required for every campground site, through Suffolk County's online system (reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov, the county's WebTrac site), which needs a Green Key login. Non-residents buy either the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key (1 year, non-resident rates, and a camping reservation made with it must be at least FOUR nights) or the $200 Non-Resident VIP Green Key (1 year, resident rates). Outer-beach camping is separate: first come, first served, beach conditions permitting. Check-out 12 pm.

booking.source: https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Our-Parks/Smith-Point-County-Park ('Reservations are required for all the sites in the campground'; 'Outer beach camping is available on first come, first served basis, beach conditions permitting'; 'Book a Camping Trip' -> https://www.reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov/) + https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Green-Key-Card ('The Green Key card is also required to access the online reservation system for camping'; 'Non-Resident Reservation Green Key: This $50 Green Key allows the user to access our online reservation system for Camping and Golf to make reservations. Applies Non-Resident rates for all purchases. When making a camping reservation, it requires the user to make a MINIMUM FOUR NIGHTS stay.'; 'The $200 Non-Resident VIP Green Key allows non-residents access our online reservation system for Camping and Golf at resident rates') + 2019 welcome booklet ('Check-Out is 12PM'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Beach concessions in the campground (food, grill service, ice cream); dump station use costs $10 without a reservation.

flags: Criteria/minimum-stay (same as Indian Island 1448, dropped for it): Suffolk County's Green Key page says a camping reservation made with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key 'requires the user to make a MINIMUM FOUR NIGHTS stay'. It is a county-wide rule of the camping reservation system, and Smith Point books only through that system ('Reservations are required for all the sites in the campground'; 'Book a Camping Trip' -> reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov), so it applies here: a non-resident must book 4+ nights at non-resident (double) rates, or buy the $200 Non-Resident VIP Green Key (resident rates; no minimum stated). Recorded in booking.note, not min_stay, because min_stay cannot say 'non-residents only'.

Phone: the 2019 campground booklet gives a Campground Office number, (631) 852-1314; the entry's (631) 852-1340 is the park's general information line on the county page. Either works; the campground office may be the better one.
